common.scope: Only the three existing WP42 §5.3 reset rows: actual finite producers, state, reached consumers, qualified tail and next read. No all-Move/AI/ability/item/system approval.
common.premise: Fixed R valid ordinary objects and identities; no plugin mutation or concurrent mutation. The actual call must reach the indicated write. Dynamic Protect @effect is resolved by the complete constructors and base definition, not by a missing literal assignment.
common.battler_tail: pbEndOfRoundPhase reaches lines 710 onward after the three positive-decision returns and continual checks. allBattlers snapshots existing nonfainted battlers at this point; each is reset sequentially. A replacement is the then-current occupant. The two side resets and field resets follow separately.
common.ordinary: Reached live-battler tail performs each specified write. Side 0 then side 1 and field are processed even though their flags are not properties of one surviving battler.
common.refused_or_failed: Refusal before a producer write leaves that write unperformed. Earlier counters or flags already written by the reached prefix can remain; reset does not require the move to have succeeded.
common.cancel: Command/UI cancellation before a move executes produces no move effect through these definitions. pbCancelMoves is a separate reached cleanup and does not clear this entire tail list. It must not be treated as an EOR-tail substitute.
common.exception_partial_commit: The complete EOR and use/hit methods contain no rollback/ensure transaction for this list. If a callback/message/animation raises, writes before that point remain, later writes need not occur. No host continuation or recovery behavior is asserted.
common.faint_boundary: allBattlers excludes HP <= 0. Formal pbFaint can already have called pbInitEffects(false), which clears these battler fields and replaces attacker arrays before EOR early return. Merely skipping a later tail does not undo those earlier resets.
common.persistence: These are battler effects/history or battle side/field runtime fields. Tail reset is not HP/status/stage/item/party rollback, serialization, or reload. HP producer writes through to the party creature; the tail does not reverse it. Full save/reload remains outside this finite contract and NOT_EXECUTED.
common.independence: New real receiver for this finite slice; original parent FULL_FILE_READ identities are retained only in selected original objects. No claim that the receiver read every source file completely; no finding counterproposal vote.

rows.producer: Protect base writes the constructor-selected battler flag only after its failure gates; duplicate/last-in-round/rate refusal does not execute the setter.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Stops qualifying protectable moves and can poison a qualifying contact attacker; after false, this flag no longer supplies that protection.

rows.producer: Target-specific effect sets true after duplicate/already-moved gates; no setter on a rejected target.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Existing Electric type data is required; true overrides the calculated type. After false, base type and any other type modifiers decide.

rows.producer: Protect base resolves the Endure constructor effect and sets the battler flag on the reached general effect.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: A lethal hit uses this flag after nonlethal-move handling; after false, Endure itself supplies no HP-1 survival.

rows.producer: The shared flinch producer rejects active Inner Focus unless Mold Breaker; move/item/ability paths call it.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: A reached ordinary action can be prevented and mark failure; false removes this flinch reason. Special skipped accuracy/status checks have their own gate.

rows.producer: Attack phase charge-message dispatch sets readiness before move execution; same class reads readiness and tookMoveDamageThisRound.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Readiness false alone does not create a prior-charge damage failure; next attack phase may charge again.

rows.producer: Target must be nonfainted, not already helped, and still eligible to act; reached target effect sets true.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Damage power multiplier reads true except Confusion; false removes this contribution and the duplicate-effect refusal.

rows.producer: Dynamic Protect base writes this resolved constructor flag.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Qualifying damaging protectable moves can be blocked and contact Attack loss requested; false removes this protection source.

rows.producer: Targeted or nontargeted eligible status reflection sets the used flag; the ability gate and old false value are both checked.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Used flag suppresses a second Magic Bounce use through that branch; false permits a later qualified reflection. Ability itself is not removed.

rows.producer: General effect sets true. A qualified reflection can consume it earlier by setting false.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Both targeted and nontargeted reflection branches read/consume it; false removes this temporary reflection source.

rows.producer: Dynamic Protect base writes the Obstruct flag after the shared gates.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Qualifying damaging contact moves can be blocked and Defense loss requested; false removes this source.

rows.producer: Duplicate rejected; reached target effect sets true.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: A Fire move reads Powder after usage counters/start-use. It marks failure and may damage the user; after false, Powder does not intercept the next Fire move.

rows.producer: PriorityChange on a status move sets saved origin true; rough AI priority explicitly untriggers it after its own query.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: The generation-7+ opposing Dark immunity reads this saved origin. Tail false is not removal of the ability; next priority calculation can set it again.

rows.producer: After computing bracket values, both saved flags are cleared, then nonzero selected ability subpriority sets this one.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: The attack message/use dispatcher reads the saved flag and current ability activity. Tail false does not clear the cached priority entry; a later calculation can rewrite it.

rows.producer: Selected item subpriority sets this when ability has no bracket effect or the faster item overrides a slower ability.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Message/use dispatch checks this in the elsif after ability source and current item activity; consumption can occur there. Tail false does not refund any item.

rows.producer: Constructor sets Protect identity; shared general effect sets it dynamically after failure gates.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Qualifying protectable moves are stopped; false removes the Protect source. ProtectRate is not reset by this C0607 tail row.

rows.producer: Redirection general effect sets FollowMe order and sets RagePowder only when the move is powder-classified.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Real targeting checks powder eligibility plus FollowMe order. Clearing both tail fields removes this redirection; AI finite scoring reads are kept distinct from execution.

rows.producer: Healing failure can reject full HP before the general effect. Reached parent recovery/message occurs before the Roost setter, so an error in that prefix can omit the flag.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Type queries temporarily omit Flying and add Normal if otherwise empty; false exposes then-current underlying types, not a saved-original-type restore. Other type setters can clear it earlier.

rows.producer: Dynamic Protect base writes the resolved SpikyShield flag.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Qualifying moves are blocked, with qualifying contact recoil; false removes this protection source.

rows.original_assertion: Counter damagevalue becomes−1 and separatelyCounterTarget pointer−1.
rows.producer: A recorded non-Substitute physical hit stores damage and the user index, including the separate target pointer.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Pointer < 0 prevents adding a target; otherwise fixed damage uses the stored value. Tail -1 for both prevents an old hit target from being reused.
rows.reset: Counter damagevalue becomes−1 and separatelyCounterTarget pointer−1.

rows.original_assertion: MirrorCoat damagevalue becomes−1 and separatelyMirrorCoatTarget pointer−1.
rows.producer: A recorded non-Substitute special hit stores damage and its user index separately.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Pointer < 0 prevents adding a target. Tail -1 for both drops the old target/damage pair; no party HP is restored.
rows.reset: MirrorCoat damagevalue becomes−1 and separatelyMirrorCoatTarget pointer−1.

rows.producer: Setup general effect clears own token, then writes the waiting ally token and MoveNext; normal combo use reads token in base type/start-use and consumes it only in general effect.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: All-target failure occurs before general consumption; after-all-hits still runs and may write combo side effects. Token can remain until live tail nil; next start-use then cannot form a combo from that stale token.

rows.producer: Reached redirection setter chooses an ordering counter greater than current ally counters.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Real single-foe redirection selects lower positive valid counter after Spotlight. Tail 0 removes this candidate; RagePowder is separately cleared.

rows.producer: General effect chooses a positive ordering counter above existing live battlers.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Eligible snatchable status use selects the lowest nonzero counter, consumes it to 0, changes user, target and Mold Breaker; tail 0 removes any unused candidate.

rows.producer: Target effect sets an ordering counter greater than its current allies.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Real redirection considers valid positive Spotlight before FollowMe/Rage Powder; tail 0 removes it. AI reads are a separate heuristic, not proof of identical execution.

rows.producer: Every reached damage-record operation stores this hit damage, with Substitute distinctions handled per field.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: AI Substitute score reads the raw last damage threshold; tail 0 removes that last-hit contribution for the next read.

rows.producer: Only when recorded user opposes target is this damage updated; ally damage does not overwrite it through this branch.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Metal Burst reads 1.5 times this amount after choosing the last foe attacker; tail 0 plus empty foe history prevents old damage reuse.

rows.producer: Registered HP loss sets true only across the strict below-half boundary; recovery to half or more clears it. Effect-damage entry clears before/after its reached reactions.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Emergency Exit/Wimp Out entry and Berserk read it under their own gates. False skips the former field gate and Berserk half-cross check; no lost HP is refunded.

rows.producer: Positive actual basic stage loss, selected direct stage replacement/reversal and reset-from-positive paths set true. Several action/entry paths clear it earlier.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Eject Pack entry requires true and active item; clearing prevents stale event reuse. This is separate from statsLoweredThisRound and does not restore stages or consumed item.

rows.producer: Registered positive HP loss sets true; damage recording separately sets it for positive non-Substitute damage. The field name does not prove every producer was direct move damage.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Focus Punch readiness plus this flag can fail. Tail false permits next-round focus unless fresh damage sets it again; HP remains changed.

rows.producer: Registered positive HP loss and positive recorded hit damage set true; record may include Substitute damage for this field.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Assurance reads this marker for doubled base power. Tail false removes the previous-round contribution, not damage itself.

rows.producer: The Shell Trap reaction sets true only for an opposing physical hit, actual positive non-Substitute HP loss, and a selected still-unmoved trap action; also requests MoveNext.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Shell Trap use-message/failure reads this flag. Tail false removes a prior-round trigger; ShellTrap effect has a separate action-end reset.

rows.producer: Positive basic stage gain, direct comparisons/swaps/reversal, Anger Point and White Herb reached writes can set this history flag.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Burning Jealousy additional effect delegates burn only if this marker is true. Tail false removes that previous-round condition; raised stages remain.

rows.producer: Actual basic loss and direct comparison/reset/reversal paths mark lowering; same paths may separately mark statsDropped.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Lash Out doubles when this history is true. Tail false removes previous-round doubling while actual stages are retained.

rows.producer: Weather-change form check marks eligible nontransformed, living Eiscue form 1 with raw Ice Face when effective weather is Hail and this is not an ability-change call.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: EOR weather dispatch plus active ability/effective Hail reads this token and form; tail false removes stale restoration permission. No generic reset of form is inferred.

rows.producer: Use entry resets current failure; reached denial/failure paths can set true, while Call/SwitchOut/UseItem set false and Pledge setup sets true. Not all failed hits set the same value (protected-only target loop is special).
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Tail copies current failure to prior-round failure without clearing current. Stomping Tantrum reads the copied value next round, not an arbitrary success/failed label inferred from animation.

rows.producer: Reached record appends user index (not restricted to opposing users); the array is initialized independently.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Revenge/Avalanche membership reads target index. Tail clears this same array in place; an existing alias sees empty history.

rows.original_assertion: lastFoeAttacker array separately cleared in place.
rows.producer: Reached record appends only opposing user indices to a separate array.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Metal Burst selects the last recorded opposing index. Tail clears the same array in place, so no old target is selected.
rows.reset: lastFoeAttacker array separately cleared in place.

rows.producer: Rejects already-active side flag and last-in-round; reached general effect sets own side true.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Status protection check reads true under its target gates; tail false permits a later valid new use and removes old side protection.

rows.producer: First-turn and last-in-round checks precede the general side setter.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Qualifying damaging moves read the side flag; tail false removes this source. First-turn qualification itself is not reset.

rows.producer: Constructor resolves sidedEffect and QuickGuard; base reads/writes side effects dynamically.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Reads saved positive move priority with protectability and bypass gates; false removes old guard but does not change move priority.

rows.producer: Constructor selects WideGuard side effect; shared failure/general methods implement the actual setter.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Reads multi-target/other gates and generation rules. Tail false removes old guard; unrelated field state is retained.

rows.producer: Successful entry to hit body reaches general setter and may advance a compatible unmoved ally. All-target failure before general leaves a starting false Round false.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Base damage reads existing side flag before this use sets it; tail false means first next-round Round has no stale doubling. MoveNext is not one of these side resets.

rows.original_assertion: If EchoedVoiceUsed false, EchoedVoiceCounter becomes0; then EchoedVoiceUsed false unconditionally.
rows.producer: Usage-counter override increments once per side-round (capped 5), then sets Used true, before subsequent target/failure/hit checks. Failures before usage-counter entry differ.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Tail tests old Used first: false => Counter 0; true => retain Counter. It then clears Used. Next use increments retained count; next unused tail resets count. Do not clear Used before testing it.
rows.reset: If EchoedVoiceUsed false, EchoedVoiceCounter becomes0; then EchoedVoiceUsed false unconditionally.

rows.producer: Nondamaging use rejects already active/last-in-round; damaging variant bypasses that failure branch. Reached general setter is idempotent when already true.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: With Electric type data present, true changes Normal calculated move type; tail false removes this field contribution. Electrify is separate.

rows.producer: Fusion Bolt caches the opposite flag before shared usage-counter reset clears BOTH field flags, then its reached general effect sets Bolt true. Other moves also clear both on counter entry.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Fusion Flare caches Bolt before clearing. An all-target failed Bolt has already cleared both but never reaches its general true setter. EOR false prevents carrying a successful Bolt token across the tail.

rows.producer: Fusion Flare symmetrically caches Bolt before parent clears both; reached general sets Flare true. This is a per-use sequence as well as EOR lifetime.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Fusion Bolt multiplier/animation uses its cached opposite flag. Tail false removes only the shared field token, not a move object cache already computed for a use.

rows.original_assertion: Field FairyLock positivecounter decrements1; zero/negative unchanged.
rows.producer: Duplicate positive lock rejected; reached general sets 2.
rows.consumption_and_next_read: Positive field value participates in trappedInBattle. Certain switching/escape and Ghost bypasses precede it; duringBattle run bypasses that trapping block. Tail decrements only positive: 2->1, next reached tail 1->0; zero/negative unchanged.
rows.reset: Field FairyLock positivecounter decrements1; zero/negative unchanged.
